name: Hi no Hikari no Shita de
source:
One summer vacation day Yurika took a drive with her visiting elder cousin.
Who taught her how to publicly expose herself.
It was thrilling, a first time bewilderment of shame and freedom.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE100823.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个暑假的一天，尤里卡和她来访的表弟一起开车兜风。
谁教她如何公开暴露自己的。
这是令人兴奋的，第一次对羞耻和自由感到困惑。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE100823.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
